# Swizel Technologies

> Custom software, mobile apps, web platforms and digital marketing from Abuja, Nigeria. We design, build and ship products for startups, SMEs and institutions, and we run a hands-on tech bootcamp.

Website: https://www.swizel.co
Contact: https://www.swizel.co/contact

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.swizel.co/): who we are and what we build
- [About](https://www.swizel.co/about): the team and how we work
- [Services](https://www.swizel.co/services): software development, product design, digital marketing
- [Portfolio](https://www.swizel.co/portfolio): case studies of shipped products
- [Blog](https://www.swizel.co/blog): articles on tech, product and growth
- [Contact](https://www.swizel.co/contact): start a project

## Notes

- The site offers five reading views (Boardroom, Builder, Founder, Campus, Studio). The default Boardroom view at the clean URLs above is the canonical content.
